skillTree.localised_description: The weight of every single insult, grievance, umbrage and ill-feeling, channelled into a single, crushing swing of the axe.
The shadow of the Ruinous Powers looms large, protecting those who bear their mark.
Standing face to face with your enemy means getting to watch the light fade from their eyes when you win.
Having learned much in their long years of service, this character now turns their attention to training others.

skillTree.localised_description: "You...weak! Hu-Mung-Us...STRONG!"

With a towering stature blessed by Khorgar and a mind which is an affront to Tchar, Hu-Mung-Us lives for one purpose—the death of weak foes. And for airag. And meat. And...on second thought...wait, what's a "thought?"

related_attributes.bullet_text: A unit with Executioner will execute units in combat below a 20% hit points threshold.

skillTree.localised_description: When a huge swathe of rage and violence descends upon the unready, very few survivors are left in its wake.
No foe remains a threat once torn limb from bloody limb!
"The enemy's fear; their blood spilt in the mud – these are the things that sustain me."
"Raze it all to the ground! Leave nothing standing!"
With every other thought squeezed from his mind, there is naught left of this one but the screaming song of slaughter.
From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.
Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.
"None shall run far! None shall be able to hide! All will come to sufferance!"
The iron will and indomitable presence of this leader ensures their followers remain steadfast when facing peril.
The scars on this storied warrior reveal a veteran of many battles, a being not easy to kill and one worthy of respect and fear.
The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.
This champion extols discipline and fear away from the battlefield as much as on it.
